practice.label: Steady Practice
practice.title: Practicing release before the grip returns
practice.issueStatement: Control is not usually undone in one dramatic surrender. It loosens where the heart keeps practicing smaller acts of trust before urgency rebuilds the old grip.
practice.centralInsight: Gurbani trains release by returning the soul to Hukam again and again. The steadier life is not inactive; it is active without trying to become absolute.
practice.practicalReflection: The grip returns through repetition, so release must also be repeated. The heart learns trust by what it stops clutching every ordinary day.
